name: XEROPHYLLUM
key_symptoms: Feels full and heavy. Eructations sour; offensive, an hour after luncheon and dinner. Vomiting at 2 pm.
Feels full, stuffed up, pain across forehead and above eyes. Great pressure at root of nose. Bewildered. Loss of consciousness. Pulsating headache.
Posterior nares raw; discharge thick, yellow mucus. Sneezing. Trachea sore; lumps feel constricted.
Muscular lameness, trembling. Pain in knees. Limbs feel stiff (Rhus).
Feels hot from sacrum to scapulć. Backache, extending down legs. Pain over kidneys. Heat deep in spine.

mind_symptoms: Dull, cannot concentrate mind for study; forgets names; writes last letters of words first; misspells common words.
head_symptoms: Feels full, stuffed up, pain across forehead and above eyes. Great pressure at root of nose. Bewildered. Loss of consciousness. Pulsating headache.

gi_symptoms: Feels full and heavy. Eructations sour; offensive, an hour after luncheon and dinner. Vomiting at 2 pm.
urinary_symptoms: Bearing-down sensation. Vulva inflamed, with furious itching. Increased sexual desire, with ovarian and uterine pains and leucorrhśa.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Muscular lameness, trembling. Pain in knees. Limbs feel stiff (Rhus).
skin_symptoms: Erythema, with vesication and intense itching, stinging, and burning. Blisters, little lumps. Skin rough and cracked; feels like leather. Dermatitis, especially around knees. Inflammation resembling poison-oak. Inguinal glands and behind knee swollen.

source.title: XEROPHYLLUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
